name: Built-in dictation
note: Speech-to-text built into the product, run by the vendor
summary: The agent product records the user's microphone locally and streams the audio to the vendor's own transcription service. The transcript is inserted into the prompt, where it can be mixed with typing, and is sent as a normal message. It covers speech in only: replies stay text.
how: Turn dictation on in the product (in Claude Code, /voice)
Hold or tap a key to start recording
Audio streams to the vendor's speech-to-text service
The transcript is inserted into the prompt and sent as a normal message
facts: Claude Code (CLI and VS Code extension)
Vendor's servers; audio is not processed locally
Speech in only; no spoken replies
No setup or API key, but tied to the vendor account
watchOut: No spoken replies or voice conversation
Needs a local microphone; not in cloud, SSH or remote IDE sessions
Claude Code: claude.ai sign-in only, not API keys, Bedrock, Google Cloud or Foundry
